name: Haneoka Sana
source:
A petite and childlike student. Curious and gullible, but also a bit meek.
The girl is a child in many aspect, and she is protected by many of her classmates. She loves cute things, which include outfits she made herself.
She is too naive to understand sex and struggles with sexual education.
